property_summary: When the _tos array has length 1, the reference P stops after 1 iteration and returns true, while the mutant M does an out-of-bounds access by checking _tos[1] and reverts. The test asserts that calling transfer with _tos=[address(1)] and v=[0] returns true, which passes on C but fails on the mutant.
change_summary: Change the loop condition from < to <= to allow an extra iteration with out-of-bounds access.
